# Rosetta3 C++23 API

Zhang, Y., & Schaap, M. G. (2017). Weighted recalibration of the Rosetta pedotransfer model with improved estimates of hydraulic parameter distributions and summary statistics (Rosetta3). Journal of Hydrology, 547, 39-53.

The reviewed CC0 model is bundled. Use `ptfkit_rosetta3_builtin` (C) or `Rosetta3::builtin` (C++) without a file. External PTFKNN01 loading remains available with pinned SHA-256 `d4d2ca39f41762830f736c70fba16ed68a81cb52d4639b1f48c6a24e502c4796`. Invalid predictors, containers and digest mismatches are errors.

`models.h` / `ptfkit.models` provides owned, immutable generic model loading and original-scale network prediction. Rosetta3 requires the pinned complete-container digest. C models must be freed exactly once with `ptfkit_model_free`; C++ models use move-only RAII. Never share a C handle with a thread that frees it. Predictions on a live model use no shared mutable state.

Rosetta3 levels are explicit. Modes 0/1/2 are arithmetic/log10/geometric. The 14 outputs are seven means then seven sample standard deviations (ddof=1), ordered theta_r, theta_s, alpha, n, Ksat, K0, L. Geometric estimates retain physical-scale SDs. Fixed-level functions use arithmetic mode; the model prediction interface exposes all three modes.

## `calc_ptf_zhang2017_mod2`

Estimate Rosetta3 level 2 physical-scale arithmetic means and uncertainty.

Requires a loaded model plus sand, silt, clay. Returns named hydraulic means and sample SDs.

## `calc_ptf_zhang2017_mod3`

Estimate Rosetta3 level 3 physical-scale arithmetic means and uncertainty.

Requires a loaded model plus sand, silt, clay, bulk_density. Returns named hydraulic means and sample SDs.

## `calc_ptf_zhang2017_mod4`

Estimate Rosetta3 level 4 physical-scale arithmetic means and uncertainty.

Requires a loaded model plus sand, silt, clay, bulk_density, theta_33. Returns named hydraulic means and sample SDs.

## `calc_ptf_zhang2017_mod5`

Estimate Rosetta3 level 5 physical-scale arithmetic means and uncertainty.

Requires a loaded model plus sand, silt, clay, bulk_density, theta_33, theta_1500. Returns named hydraulic means and sample SDs.

## Result fields

- `theta_r_mean` (cm^3/cm^3): Arithmetic ensemble mean. Residual volumetric water content.
- `theta_s_mean` (cm^3/cm^3): Arithmetic ensemble mean. Saturated volumetric water content.
- `alpha_mean` (1/cm): Arithmetic ensemble mean. van Genuchten inverse pressure-scale parameter.
- `n_mean` (1): Arithmetic ensemble mean. van Genuchten pore-size parameter.
- `k_sat_mean` (cm/day): Arithmetic ensemble mean. Saturated hydraulic conductivity.
- `k_0_mean` (cm/day): Arithmetic ensemble mean. Unsaturated conductivity matching-point parameter; not saturated conductivity.
- `l_mean` (1): Arithmetic ensemble mean. Unsaturated conductivity exponent from the separate Rosetta1 ensemble.
- `theta_r_std` (cm^3/cm^3): Sample standard deviation (ddof=1), in physical parameter units. Residual volumetric water content.
- `theta_s_std` (cm^3/cm^3): Sample standard deviation (ddof=1), in physical parameter units. Saturated volumetric water content.
- `alpha_std` (1/cm): Sample standard deviation (ddof=1), in physical parameter units. van Genuchten inverse pressure-scale parameter.
- `n_std` (1): Sample standard deviation (ddof=1), in physical parameter units. van Genuchten pore-size parameter.
- `k_sat_std` (cm/day): Sample standard deviation (ddof=1), in physical parameter units. Saturated hydraulic conductivity.
- `k_0_std` (cm/day): Sample standard deviation (ddof=1), in physical parameter units. Unsaturated conductivity matching-point parameter; not saturated conductivity.
- `l_std` (1): Sample standard deviation (ddof=1), in physical parameter units. Unsaturated conductivity exponent from the separate Rosetta1 ensemble.
